text:
Anya (pm): quick sync — planning Q for the BYOK + retention UX workstream for enterprise launches. we need acceptance criteria that cover: onboarding UX, KMS handshake, export/evidence format for audits, and defaults for retention. putting this here before the triage meeting. who wants to own the acceptance list?

Mark (eng-infra): I can draft infra-level acceptance items. high-level: 1) key handshake must complete within 10s for onboarding, 2) a toggle to opt into vaulted keys per-tenant, 3) export endpoint that returns gzipped JSONL with signed manifest. will mock an API.

Sofia (security): +1 on export manifest. also add: HSM/KMS integration must log successful/failed wrap/unwrap ops to audit pipeline (immutable). SOC2 evidence needs tamper-evident logs for any key ops. one question: do we require key escrow for gov customers?

Li (eng-runtime): FYI runtime needs a deterministic fallback when KMS unavailable — can't block inference entirely. propose: fallback to ephemeral in-process key for <30s + trigger automatic rollback to hosted model. we should include SLA tradeoffs in acceptance.

Rachel (cs): customer ask from Beta A: they want ability to request full audit export in vendor-ready format (for legal). also want an onboarding checklist for BYOK: steps, estimated time, and rollback instruction in case of bad handshake.

Ben (product): can we make the BYOK onboarding a 3-step flow in Console (wizard): 1) Register key (test wrap/unwrap), 2) Choose retention policy + evidence options, 3) Confirm & schedule migration. acceptance: wizard completes end-to-end with sample customer key.

Anya (pm): here's a first pass acceptance criteria (very terse) — please react / edit. this will be part of the launch criteria doc.

```
BYOK + Retention UX Acceptance (draft):
- Onboarding: Console wizard completes key registration and test wrap/unwrap within 20s for 90% of attempts.
- KMS handshake: Successful wrap/unwrap recorded in audit logs with request_id, key_id, user_id.
- Export: Admin can trigger evidence export (gzipped JSONL) containing: audit log slice, key ops, and signed manifest sha256.
- Retention defaults: tenant default = 90 days; enterprise tier can request 365/730 windows via contract.
- Runtime fallback: when KMS unavailable, runtime serves using ephemeral key for <=30s and marks traces; incidents logged.
- SOC2 pack: one-click packaging for auditor with signed manifest and rotation history.
- Rollout: feature gate + canary to 5% tenants, automated rollback if error rate >0.5% or export latency >15s.
```

Sofia (security): minor edits: add "proof of possession" step for key registration (client signs nonce). and require KMS rotation metadata (previous_key_id) in manifest.

Mark (eng-infra): added. infra note: export must stream to S3-compatible location with pre-signed URL and minimum retention of 30 days. also need idempotency token for export job creation.

Li (eng-runtime): runtime note: include a per-request header `X-Key-Mode: ephemeral|kms` so downstream logs can be filtered. also: cache TTL for key material should default to 300s but be configurable per-tenant.

Rachel (cs): ops playbook ask: include runbook steps for emergency key rotation and a support script to generate evidence for legal hold. I'll draft with support team.

Ben (product): should we make "evidence export" a paid add-on or include in enterprise by default? sales input pls. @Rachel any blowback from customers?

Rachel (cs): most enterprise customers expect audit exports as part of enterprise bundle. add-on conversation only for long-term archival retention beyond contract.

Anya (pm): ok ownership proposal: Mark = infra acceptance, Li = runtime + headers, Sofia = security acceptance + manifest schema, Rachel = CS runbook + customer examples, Ben = pricing recommendation. I'll consolidate into the launch criteria doc and add the canary rollout plan.

Mark (eng-infra): blocked: need a minimal S3 bucket naming strategy for evidence. @Anya can you confirm we use dedicated per-tenant bucket vs shared with prefix? preference is per-tenant for isolation.

Anya (pm): prefer per-tenant for isolation, but call out cost. add decision checkpoint in the doc.

Sofia (security): also: legal hold mode — when active we must freeze automatic deletion for the tenant; export jobs still allowed. add to acceptance.

Li (eng-runtime): quick implementation note for canary: route 5% by cookie + header override for QA. will add rollout flags to the SDK.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: feature-branch/byo-wizard -> staging at 2024-10-12T03:00Z :rocket:

Ben (product): thanks all — can we have a short review thread before Thurs EOD? I'll draft the consolidated acceptance and post for sign-off. :thumbsup:

Anya (pm): yes please — target sign-off Thurs 5pm PT. I'll add owners and timeline to the doc.

Rachel (cs): I'll collect 2 customer reference cases that require longer retention to help pricing decision.

Sofia (security): note, add a checklist item: KMS key algorithm/version supported (RSA vs AES-GCM vs future post-quantum). will add to schema.

Anya (pm): perfect. action items summarized: Mark infra acceptance doc, Li runtime headers + fallback spec, Sofia manifest schema + security checklist, Rachel runbook + customer examples, Ben pricing rec, Anya consolidate + schedule sign-off.

Ben (product): tagging this thread into the roadmap epic so it surfaces in planning board. :spiral_calendar:

Anya (pm): end — thanks everyone.
